answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks through quadratic slashing. Each agent posts a refundable bond to join. If audits trace N linked identities back to one operator, the slash grows with N squared rather than N, so every extra clone costs more than the last. A falcon sentinel follows the thread of payments to a common funder; even at the zenith of its reach, an attacker who doubles fake identities quadruples expected loss, while an honest agent holding one bond never pays a penalty.
